title: git-worktrees
description: Root node for the proposal to run Cartographer topics in isolated Git worktrees.

title: README workflow docs
description: Explains Cartographer's proposal-plan-implement workflow and commit-worthy `.plan/<topic>` artifacts that worktree mode must document.
why_relevant: User-facing documentation should teach topic worktree setup, status, merge, and cleanup.

title: README What gets written
description: Documents topic artifacts under `.plan/<topic>/` as intentional rationale to review and commit.

title: Proposal skill
description: Creates `.plan/<topic>/proposal.md` plus map/fact artifacts; worktree mode should be available before proposal artifacts are written for a new topic.

title: Plan skill
description: Converts proposal artifacts into ordered phases; worktree metadata should flow into plans and handoff guidance.

title: Implement skill
description: Executes phases with git status checks and commits; primary place to enforce topic branch/worktree safety and merge readiness.

title: Index-project skill
description: Defines `.plan/_index` as generated/ignored and topic graph artifacts as source-of-truth; worktree mode must regenerate indexes per checkout.

title: Cartographer extension tools
description: Registers deterministic helper tools; possible integration point for a future `cartographer_worktree` wrapper around Git worktree status/create/finalize commands.

title: Worktree workflow helper script
description: Proposed Python helper for safe create/status/merge-ready/cleanup operations against temporary test repositories and real user-selected worktree paths.

title: Pathfinder implementation agent
description: Single-phase writer agent that should receive worktree path, branch, and stop-rule metadata when implementing a topic branch.

title: Auditor agent
description: Semantic reviewer that should confirm deterministic worktree/merge-readiness receipts when topic implementation finishes.

title: Workflow docs tests
description: Existing tests assert workflow guidance appears in skills; can be extended to cover worktree guidance in proposal/plan/implement docs.

title: Index project tests
description: Existing temporary-repository tests cover `.plan/_index` behavior and retrieval; useful model for worktree helper tests that must not mutate the real `.plan/`.

title: Package scripts
description: Defines project validation commands such as `npm run check`, `npm run test:py`, and `npm run test:ts` for proposed implementation phases.
